title: Enums with Computed Properties & Static Members
hints: Enums can have computed properties and static members, just like structs.
`static func named(_ name: String) -> Planet? { Planet(rawValue: name.lowercased()) }`.
jsBridge: Enums can have computed properties, static members and methods, like a TS enum merged with a namespace of helpers, but type-safe and exhaustive.

compass.q: TS: `enum Planet {}` plus `namespace Planet { export function … }`. What's cleaner about Swift?
Can an enum have stored properties? What's the workaround (associated values, computed)?
Enum with computed properties vs a struct with static instances (`Planet.mercury`): which is extensible by others?
